sloka: सा निकृत्तैव सालस्य यष्टिः परशुना वने ।पपात सहसा देवी देवतेव दिवश्च्युता ॥२-२०-३२॥
transliteration: sā nikṛttaiva sālasya yaṣṭiḥ paraśunā vane ।papāta sahasā devī devateva divaścyutā ॥2-20-32॥

translations.english: All on a sidden Kausalya fell down on the ground like the branch of a sal tree in the forest severed by an axe, like a goddess dropped from heaven.
